items.title: Why is optical rebounding? The industry's current focus and marginal hotspots, and where large-cap and small-cap optical names diverge
items.summary: From the panic selloff in July, to a sector rebound of more than 35 percent since August, to the high-volatility rebalancing of September, the optical communications industry is going through a recalibration of expectations driven by three forces: earnings delivery, supply bottlenecks and generational technology change.

items.title: Venezuela close to a deal to move 4 billion dollars of gold from London to New York
items.summary: Venezuela's government and opposition are close to an agreement to move central bank gold reserves from the Bank of England to the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, a step that would end a seven-year legal dispute and open new financing channels for the economically troubled South American country.
